expectations.text: Cites Decree No. 330/2026/ND-CP, issued and effective August 19, 2026, as the operative sanctions regime (82 articles, 33 on personal data protection)
expectations.evidence: No mention of Decree 330/2026; relies on "Decree 13/2023/ND-CP" and says fine schedules "were still being finalized through 2025–2026"

expectations.text: States the serious cross-border penalty structure correctly: percentage-of-revenue fines on prior-year VIETNAM-market revenue in bands — 1–2% (10k–<100k data subjects), 2–3% (100k–<1M), 3–5% (≥1M subjects or national defence/security impact)
expectations.evidence: Only "potentially up to 5% of a violating company's total revenue in the preceding fiscal year in Vietnam" as a draft-era shift; no 1–2%/2–3%/3–5% data-subject bands

expectations.text: States the fixed-fine fallback: VND tiers up to 3 billion where there is no Vietnam revenue or the percentage falls below the fixed tier
expectations.evidence: No fixed-fine fallback tiers up to VND 3 billion; cites obsolete caps "roughly 100 million–500 million VND"

expectations.text: Covers unlawful data trading: 2×–10× unlawful proceeds, with fixed fines up to VND 3 billion where proceeds are indeterminable
expectations.evidence: Data trading addressed only as Penal Code criminal exposure ("imprisonment terms... up to 7 years"); no 2×–10× unlawful proceeds administrative fine

expectations.text: Notes organisational fines are double individual fines, and remedial measures beyond fines: suspension of processing/transfers, compulsory data destruction, disgorgement, confiscation
expectations.evidence: Mentions "suspension of data processing activities" and "confiscation of profits" but omits the organisational-fines-double-individual rule and compulsory data destruction
